# `browser-extension/services/ProviderProtocol.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/ProviderProtocol.js`

Pure OpenAI-compatible request/response helpers shared by the privileged extension transport and the browser-direct mobile fallback. This module performs no storage, network, DOM, or chrome.* work.

### `providerResponseModel(value, fallback = '')`

Normalize a provider model identifier without trusting arbitrary text.

### `providerModelAttribution({ provider = '', requestedModel = '', responseModel = '' } = {})`

Keep the requested route separate from provider-reported attribution. `model` remains backward-compatible, but modelEvidence makes an omitted or dynamic alias explicitly non-concrete so callers cannot mistake a request fallback for observed provider output.

### `normalizeProviderTools(value)`

Normalize the provider-facing projection of locally authoritative OS tools. These definitions help a model form typed calls; they never grant execution authority, which remains with the descriptor hash, graph validator, and ToolRouter after the provider response returns.

### `canonicalProviderToolCalls(payload, providerTools = [], transport = 'provider-native')`

Convert completed native provider calls into one provider-neutral batch.

### `createProviderToolStreamAccumulator(providerTools = [], transport = 'provider-native-stream')`

Accumulate provider tool-call stream fragments without executing partial arguments. Each ingest returns newly complete canonical candidates once; callers must still treat them as provisional until `finalize()` validates the complete batch atomically. Anthropic candidates require block stop.

### `providerHttpError(json, status, provider = '', responseMetadata = null)`

Construct the only provider-originated Error shape allowed to cross the AI bridge. Endpoint URLs, headers, response bodies, request content, and keys are deliberately excluded. Retryability is asserted only for unambiguous transient HTTP classes; every other status remains unclassified so the Navi broker can apply its own fail-closed policy.

### `providerFailureProjection(error)`

Return a bounded structured-clone-safe view of an AI provider failure.

### `normalizeOpenRouterRouterMetadata(value)`

Preserve only bounded routing facts. OpenRouter pipeline `data` is deliberately excluded because it is plugin-defined and may contain request material; unknown additive fields are ignored for forward compatibility.
